### You Serve
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/you-serve.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 30:24
Points:
- Returning soldiers assumed their frontline combat made them more deserving of the plunder than those who stayed behind.
- David rejected this selfish mindset, establishing the principle that supply keepers and battlefield soldiers share equally.
- God places equal value on visible leadership roles and unseen, behind-the-scenes support ministries.
- Unnoticed service may feel insignificant on earth, but God sees and rewards all faithful obedience in heaven.
